title: Satellogic True Color
description: Three-band true color (RGB) composite from Satellogic's high-resolution four-band multispectral satellites (sub-meter to approximately 1 m; the Typhoon Sinlaku deliveries are 0.5 m L1D super-resolution), combining the red, green, and blue bands to show the surface as it would appear to the naked eye from space. Uint8 RGB; pixels outside the scene footprint are 0 in every band and declared as nodata. Access to Satellogic commercial imagery is provided through NASA's Commercial Satellite Data Acquisition (CSDA) Program.
